source_processing: Data analysis pipeline and custom scripts are provided in a github repository (https://github.com/rnabioco/rhumba/tree/master/haircut). Single cell RNA-Seq libraries were preprocessed using the 10x genomics software cellranger (3.0.2). The single cell DNA repair libraries were preprocessed to append the read 1 sequence to the paired read 2 read id using umi_tools extract(v 1.0.0 --bc-pattern CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCNNNNNNNNNN)(Smith et al. 2017) followed by poly(A) tail and template switching oligo removal from read 2 using cutadapt (v. 1.8.3 -a AAAAAAAAAAA -g AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACATGGG --minimum-length=2)  (Martin 2011). Reads were next aligned with bowtie2 (v 2.3.2 Langmead B, Salzberg S. 2012) to a repair substrate reference.

Following alignment, BAM files were processed to extract the alignment hairpin and position into a tag (XT) within the BAM file (tag_bam). UMI groups were identified and added as a tag (CB) using umi_tools group (--read-length = True --per-cell --output-bam = True --output-unmapped = True). BAM files were then sorted by cell barcode tag using samtools sort (v 1.5-4 -t CB -@ 23) (Li 2009). UMIs per hairpin_position were enumerated per cell using umi-tools count (v 0.5.3) (Smith et al. 2017) using the directional method to disambiguate similar UMI sequences.

Count tables produced by umi_tools are then converted into sparseMatrix format using the scrunchy R package (https://github.com/hesselberthlab/scrunchy, umitools_to_mtx). Matrices are the filtered to include only the cell-associated barcodes using the scrunchy R package (filter_matrix). Cell-associated barcodes are identified from the mRNA data using cellranger (v 3.0.2) from the filtered barcodes.tsv output.
Genome_build: hg38, custom repair substrate reference
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Text file containing cell barcodes, genes/features, and UMI counts per gene/feature per cell are provided

title: pbmc1_mrna
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from a healthy adult using standard protocols and captured on the 10x genomics single cell RNA-seq platform

10x genomics 3' end single cell RNA-seq kit. Alterations to protocol include, following GEM generation, RT was done at 37C for 60 min, then 53 C for 45 minutes. Following silane purification of RT products, mRNA was isolated using Ampure size selection of 0.6x. Read 1 positions 1-16 contain the 16bp cell barcode, and positions 17-26 contain a 10bp UMI. Read 2 contains the cDNA.
description: Single cell RNAseq library from the 10X genomics 3´ end kit (v2 chemistry). Fresh PBMCs were isolated from a healthy human donor.
